$description: Phone-only values for the Thread design system. Everything shared (colors, spacing, elevation, easing) comes from tokens.json; this file holds only what differs on iOS and Android. build-mobile.mjs reads both.

radius.$description: iOS corners follow the system's concentric shapes; Android follows Material 3 (full-round controls are the pill value).

type.$description: Same roles as tokens.json. ios: [point size, line height, Dynamic Type style the role scales with]. android: [sp, line height in sp]; sp follows the system font scale. Weights come from tokens.json.

motion.$description: Durations in ms. With Reduce Motion (iOS) or animations off (Android) components use no movement, fades only.

size.$description: Minimum tap target per OS (44pt, 48dp), the width of the time column beside the thread, and the widest a column of content gets on a tablet or unfolded phone.
